title: Mixing: To You by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The song ‘To You’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ seventh studio album Back To The Egg on 12 February 1979.

This day’s mixes remained unused, however, and Paul McCartney oversaw final mixes for the song on 5 April, during the final studio session for the album.
